He is fluent in many elemental languages.|[https://steamcommunity.com/market/listings/753/413150-Wizard%20%28Foil%29 Steam Description]}} The '''Wizard''', also known as '''M. Rasmodius''', is a [[Villagers|villager]] who lives in the [[Wizard's Tower]] to the far west of [[Cindersap Forest]]. ==Schedule== The Wizard does not leave the [[Wizard's Tower]] (except for certain [[Festivals|Festival]] days), and can be found there when the tower is accessible (6am to 11pm). After the player has unlocked the [[Witch's Hut]], he can be found in his tower after 11pm by using the warp spot in the [[Witch's Hut]]. The Wizard never visits the [[Ginger Island#Beach Resort|Beach Resort]] on Ginger Island. ==Gifts== {{GiftHeader}} ===Love=== {{Squote|Ahh, this is imbued with potent arcane energies. |} |} ===Four Hearts=== {{Hearts|4}} Players gain access to the basement of the [[Wizard's Tower]], where they can change their character's appearance at [[The Shrine of Illusions]] for {{Price|500}}. == Quotes == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! style="text-align: left;" | '''Regular ''' |- | '''First Meeting''' {{Squote|Ah, yes. I have predicted your arrival a long time ago, young [Player]. However, your fate is ultimately in your own hands.}} '''Regular''' {{Squote|Ah, yes. I have seen many things about your future, young [Player]. If I were to tell you, there could be grave consequences.}} {{Squote|If you have nothing important to tell me, leave me be. I have much work to do.}} {{Squote|It takes years of study to understand the language of the elementals. To actually speak their language requires a lifetime of devoted effort. One of the reasons I chose this valley as the location for my... research.}} |} ==Quests== *[[Quests#Meet the Wizard|"Meet the Wizard"]]: The morning after examining the golden scroll in the [[Bundles#Crafts Room|Crafts Room]] of the [[Community Center]], the Wizard will send you a letter saying he has information for you. Visit the [[Wizard's Tower]] and he will give you a potion that allows you to read the language of the [[Junimos]]. *[[Quests#A Dark Reagent|"A Dark Reagent"]]: The Wizard will send you a letter on the 12th of [[Winter]] requesting that you bring him a [[Void Essence]]. The reward is {{Price|1000}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart. *[[Quests#Staff of Power|"Staff of Power"]]: The Wizard will send you a letter on the 5th of Winter, year 2, requesting that you bring him an [[Iridium Bar]]. The reward is {{Price|5000}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart. *[[Quests#Dark Talisman|"Dark Talisman"]]: After completing the [[Community Center]] [[Bundles]] or the [[Joja Community Development Form]], trigger a cutscene at the [[Railroad]], where the Wizard will request that you find a [[Dark Talisman]]. Speak to [[Krobus]] in [[The Sewers]], who will remove the force-field blocking the entrance to the [[Mutant Bug Lair]]. Obtain the [[Dark Talisman]] from a chest in the Mutant Bug Lair, then bring it back to the Railroad area and place it on the artifact blocking the cave. Inside the cave is a teleportation rune which leads to the [[Witch's Swamp]]. This unlocks [[Quests#Goblin Problem|The "Goblin Problem" Quest]]. *[[Quests#Goblin Problem|"Goblin Problem"]]: Once inside the [[Witch's Swamp]], the Witch's [[Henchman]] will be blocking the way to the [[Witch's Hut]]. He will only allow the player to pass if he is given [[Void Mayonnaise]], which completes the quest [[Quests#Goblin Problem|Goblin Problem]] and gives access to the Dark Shrines inside the Witch's Hut. Recover the [[Magic Ink]] inside the Witch's Hut, then bring the ink back to the Wizard, who will unlock six [[Wizard's Tower|Wizard buildings]] for [[The Farm]]. *The Wizard may request that you slay a certain number of [[Monsters]] or bring him a random item at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]]. The reward for slaying monsters varies by the number/type of monster, but is always an amount of gold. The reward for an item delivery quest is 3x the item's base value and 150 [[Friendship]] points. *The Wizard is to be gifted the [[Quests#Arctic Shard|Arctic Shard]] in [[Quests#The Pirate's Wife|The Pirate's Wife]] quest. *[[Quests#A Curious Substance|"A Curious Substance"]]: On the Special Orders board in front of the [[Mayor's Manor]], the Wizard may randomly request that the player obtain and bring him an [[Ectoplasm]]. The reward is {{Price|2500}} and the [[Mini-Obelisk]] recipe. *[[Quests#Prismatic Jelly|"Prismatic Jelly"]]: On the Special Orders board in front of the [[Mayor's Manor]], the Wizard may randomly request that the player obtain and bring him a [[Prismatic Jelly]]. The reward is {{Price|5000}} and the [[Monster Musk]] recipe. ==Portraits== File:Wizard.png File:Wizard Surprised.png ==Trivia== *Despite being unreachable in most festivals, the Wizard has unique dialogue for every festival, some with backstory on the events. *The Wizard's shirt can be tailored with 1 [[Cloth]] and 1 [[Void Essence]], creating the [[Tailoring#Shirts|Arcane Shirt]]. ==History== {{History|1.3.27|Added unique blue stationery used exclusively for letters from the Wizard.}} {{History|1.5|Added "A Curious Substance" and "Prismatic Jelly" quests.}} {{History|1.6|Now likes [[Iridium Bar]].}} {{NavboxVillagers}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[de:Zauberer]] [[es:Rasmodius]] [[fr:Sorcier]] [[it:Mago]] [[ja:魔術師]] [[ko:마법사]] [[hu:Varázsló]] [[pt:Feiticeiro]] [[ru:Волшебник]] [[tr:Büyücü]] [[zh:法师]]
